name: ycbcr2rgb
comment: MATLAB ycbcr2rgb — YCbCr->RGB (BT.601). DOUBLE-input path: YCbCr studio [0,1] -> RGB [0,1] (clipped); pins R/G/B at two pixels, matches MATLAB R2025b to ~7 sig figs (tol=1e-6 — numkit's inverse matrix uses 8-digit-rounded coefficients vs MATLAB's full-precision inverse; ~1e-7 residual). NOTE: integer-class handling + full-precision inverse coefficients tracked in a dedicated fix task.
